rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive development toolkit that integrates code quality analysis and web scraping into AI-assisted workflows. Provides code analysis features including cyclomatic complexity calculation, security vulnerability scanning, dependency analysis, ESLint integration, and code smell detection. Also includes static and dynamic web scraping tools using Cheerio and Playwright for extracting content, discovering API endpoints, and monitoring network requests. Supports automated code reviews, security audits, dependency management, and data extraction through natural language commands in AI assistants like Claude Desktop and Cursor.
